Product Details: 50% FASTER CRIMPING - Promote productivity with this attachment that delivers 50% faster crimps without the hassle of a hand tool. LESS CRIMPING EFFORT - Limit fatigue with this PEX crimper that requires less work to finish the job. MULTI-BRAND COMPATIBILITY– Works with select DEWALT 20V MAX* and other pro-grade 18V Impact Drivers. Includes (1) DWAPXCIR PEX Crimp Ring Attachment, (1) Brace Bracket, (1) Go/No-Go Gauge QUICK-CHANGE BRACE – Attach in seconds to go from driving screws to clamping pipe. ADJUSTABLE TORQUE - Control performance for a variety of applications with adjustable torque settings. RELIABLE PERFORMANCE - Make reliably tight crimps with all-metal internal mechanisms that deliver durability and consistent performance. HELP MAXIMIZE ACCESSIBILITY - Extend your reach when working in tight spaces with this tool designed to fit in a standard joist bay and featuring 360º rotation. ONE-HANDED OPERATION - Operate the tool with one hand while maintaining control and placement of the crimp. OPTIMIZED CRIMP JAW GEOMETRY - Make high-quality crimps with patented crimp jaw geometry. VERTICAL CRIMPING - Help prevent sliding on vertical applications with wire ring supports that hold the ring in place. Applications: Plumbing attachment for use with PEX B pipe. Compatible with 1/2" and 3/4" Crimp Rings.
